title: Structure-Aware RAG: Structured Retrieval Augmented Generation from Noisy Data for Conversational Agents
authors: Kaiqiao Han; LuAn Tang; Renliang Sun; Peng Yuan; Wei Cheng; Haoyu Wang; Wei Wang; Yizhou Sun; Haifeng Chen
why_relevant: Proposes a structured (table-based) RAG framework explicitly designed to handle noisy conversational data, addressing noisy/irrelevant retrieval contexts.
why_not_or_caveat: Focus is on method design for conversational agents rather than systematic robustness analysis; relevance to broader noise/conflict taxonomy is limited.
